messages:
sam: morning — quick CVE intake for today, short triage and next actions

sam: CVE list I pulled from feed:
```
CVE-2025-3141 - libkms-client (python) - arbitrary command on key rotation endpoint - CVSS 8.2 - EPSS 0.74 - PoC public on GitHub
CVE-2025-4102 - grpc-js (npm) - denial of service via long metadata - CVSS 6.1 - EPSS 0.12 - no known exploit
CVE-2025-4187 - sqlx (rust) - SQL injection via interpolated query in legacy api - CVSS 9.0 - EPSS 0.05 - private report
CVE-2025-4210 - alpine: musl CRT - privilege escalation in container runtime - CVSS 7.4 - EPSS 0.6 - exploits observed in the wild
```

anya: flagged libkms-client as high risk for us — we ship that client in infra bootstrap bundles and the private deployment agent.

jin: ack. libkms-client: CVSS 8.2 + EPSS 0.74 + public PoC. Assume exploitable. Recommend immediate mitigations: 1) block outbound egress to kms rotation endpoint for older agents; 2) rotate keys created in last 30d where rotation was automated; 3) push hotpatch to agent.

leo: do we have a patch upstream? I can open a dep PR to upgrade to 2.1.4 if that's the fixed version.

sam: upstream released 2.1.4 with the fix. Some pinned packages still reference 2.0.x in dedicated infra images. Action: leo to open infra PRs + devops to bake new images.

devsec-bot: vulnerability alert created #VULN-2025-3141 with severity=critical, owners=eng-security, infra; ticket: https://tracker.internal/SEC-9312

anya: for sqlx (CVE-2025-4187) high CVSS but low EPSS and private disclosure. Likely limited to legacy endpoint. Suggest log sweep and WAF rule for injection signatures as quick stopgap.

jin: doing grep across logs, will post counts in 10m. If we see hits, escalate to hotpatch; otherwise schedule for next minor release.

sam: grpc-js DoS — medium. Can we apply gateway header-size limits for metadata? oncall-bot can create a temporary rule.

oncall-bot: rate-limit rule 0x7a created on API-GW for metadata_size=8kb max; active in staging.

leo: alpine/musl CRT (CVE-2025-4210) exploits in the wild. We use alpine bases in many images. Need inventory of images using alpine:3.19 and older. I'll dump list and plan rebuilds.

anya: recommend priority: rebuild infra images within 48h, prioritize images running on Dedicated/Private nodes, add canary rollouts.

sam: prioritization summary:
- P0: CVE-2025-3141 (libkms-client) — hotpatch + key rotation + infra image PR + customer advisory
- P0.5: CVE-2025-4210 (alpine/musl) — image rebuilds, canary, coordinate with customer success for Private customers
- P1: CVE-2025-4187 (sqlx) — log sweep, WAF rule, schedule patch in next minor
- P2: CVE-2025-4102 (grpc-js) — gateway rate-limiting, monitor

jin: assigning myself to libkms key rotation steps and log proof-of-exploit sweep. Will update SEC-9312.

leo: opening infra PRs and image-bake tickets. Tagging @devops for pipeline runs.

anya: audit note — for any key rotation we trigger, enable additional audit-forwarding to long-term storage (S3-Gov/LA) and mark retention metadata. Compliance needs this. Filing ticket.

sam: compliance ticket: https://tracker.internal/COM-2241

jin: quick log update — grep found 3 hits in staging for the rotation endpoint from older agent builds. Snippet:
```
2025-03-12T09:12:33Z agent-72abcd POST /kms/rotate 200 "agent/2.0.3"
2025-03-12T09:34:10Z agent-72abcd POST /kms/rotate 500 "agent/2.0.3"
2025-03-12T10:01:02Z agent-90ffee POST /kms/rotate 200 "agent/2.0.3"
```

jin: counts low but PoC exists; escalating to hotpatch. Moving to P0.

sam: hotpatch plan: 1) pin agent to libkms-client 2.1.4, 2) bake and roll agent to staging, 3) rotate keys issued in last 30d, 4) notify Private customers. Timeline: staging in ~4h, prod canary 24h.

leo: PR ready draft, will request review in 30m.

devsec-bot: SEC-9312 updated: status=hotpatching, owners=jin,leo, expected_mitigation=24h

anya: RBAC/audit question — do we need to revoke service accounts' long-lived tokens as part of rotation? If not, rotation won't stop compromised agents.

jin: yes — rotate bootstrap service account tokens and revoke old tokens. Coordinate with infra for zero-downtime. Adding steps to SEC-9312.

sam: owners: leo + jin + anya. I'll post short advisory to #customer-notify for Private customers after staging verification.

anya: adding a postmortem template to SEC-9312 to capture timeline, decisions, and lessons.

sam: thanks all — update here when staging verifies the hotpatch.
